To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the step-wise and the kernel methods are not recommended for inversion of non-event or haze data due to the overestimation of the size distribution and the presence of artificial particles, 2) the Alofs and Hagen inversion method is recommended for inversion of all types of events, and 3) the statistical hypothesis test and the concentration comparison are two important steps in the inversion process to ensure a good size distribution is recovered.

the development of a new method to recover particle size distributions from the particle size magnifer (PSM) data and to provide a better understanding of the NPF events in the troposphere.

the PSM can provide particle size distribution in the size range of 1-3 nm.
